name: trailblazer-ghost
description: Trailblazer for Ghost — the Salesforce-developer theme, ported. Token-first design, numbered post index, SLDS-navy code blocks, and a navbar that wears your reading progress as a ring.

navigation_layout.description: Island floats a rounded pill inside the page; Full welds an edge-to-edge bar.

color_scheme.description: The default before a reader touches the toggle. Their choice is remembered.

show_reading_progress.description: An accent ring (island) or hairline (full) that fills as the page scrolls.

cta_text.description: The header button's label. Empty hides the button.

cta_url.description: Where the header button goes. The default opens Ghost's signup portal.

footer_tagline.default: Built with Ghost and a lot of opinions about spacing.
footer_tagline.description: One line under the footer logo.

show_author_card.description: The author byline card under every post.
